about: Modwerk source-only cc-recall package for Digitakt I OS 1.54, compiled from sdk/digitakt/modules/cc-recall.

mods.title: CC Recall
mods.summary: After a pattern reload, pattern change, project load or STOP, the MIDI tracks send their pattern’s CC values at once instead of waiting for each track’s next trig.
mods.description: After a pattern reload, pattern change, project load or STOP, the MIDI tracks send their pattern’s CC values at once instead of waiting for each track’s next trig.
